document: Gazette of India Part II-Section 4, 02-12-1989 (archive.org in.gazette.central.w.1989-12-02.25809): S.R.O. 332 dated 26-09-1989
why_consequential: Explains the r.194 wording conflict (C-04); lists the official amendment history to 1988
observed_on_image: '2. In the Army Rules, 1954, for Rule 194, the following Rule shall be substituted: The prescribed officer for the purposes of Section 93 shall be, in the case of an officer, the Chief of the Army Staff or the Officer Commanding an Army, and in the case of a person other than an officer, the officer empowered to convene a court martial for his trial.' NOTE lists amending S.R.O.s E-7/1960 through 216/1988.
